input_requirements: One exact prescribed native cfg0 warm model, named Adam, metadata and continuation RNG per representative. Metadata alone does not establish custody.

The exact already-produced teacher_input and teacher_edge_index used during that warm fit, preferably its root-admitted actual preprocessing capture and logical fingerprint receipt. Load that capture once; never regenerate preprocessing for either closure.
The same admitted canonical edges and compact seed17 TRAIN nodes/labels for both closures. No validation-label argument or predictive score files.

The native model/optimizer must be supplied using the existing verified adapter/integration and its executed-source custody. The qualifier contains no data/checkpoint reader, restore factory, warm acquisition or fitting code.
The caller's current RNG must exactly equal the supplied warm continuation RNG. Root establishes that all inputs belong to the same current warm endpoint.

root_admission_argument.graph: Root supplies one of Squirrel or Photo

sequence: Root inspects the sealed qualifier, cache v2, the preserved installation-witness helper/runner v3 and the qualifier's narrow model-state mapping normalization, plus unchanged constants/source bindings. This plan itself is not a launch release.

Root admits a distinct source-bound engineering child under the existing authorized route/sole UUID, Torch2.1.2 and unchanged deterministic highest-FP32/no-TF32/no-autocast policy. Root's supervisor enforces the existing 32GiB free-GPU floor, 3600s per graph cap, 7200s aggregate cap, closure termination/reaping and no automatic retries.

The input provider supplies one actual native warm state plus its exact captured preprocessing. No warm fit is duplicated for cache comparison and no preprocessing is rerun. Root may use a custodied just-produced state or an explicitly admitted exact-state restore with the existing adapter; this harness does not decide replay eligibility.

The qualifier verifies source bytes, endpoint metadata, current RNG and supplied state/input fingerprints; prepares one shared identity K1/K4 prototype, original named Adam transport and original normalized adjacency.
Build original and cached closures on the same K1 model/argument tuple. Charge the cache-building full forward as a separate synchronized phase.

Invoke the unchanged selector once with the original closure and once with the cached closure, each from the same actual prototype/frozen Adam/RNG. Capture actual installations and validate each branch's five returns against its own actual witnesses.

Compare exact actual gap/radius traces, nulls/candidate statuses, selection/abstention, installed slices and all five returned model/Adam/RNG/mode snapshots. Do not independently reconstruct expected installed FP32 heads.

Compare whole-logit forwards at identity and at unique actual installed head slices; compare three inherited seed17 JVP/VJP directions and ordinary TRAIN CE gradients at identity and actual common center. Run the unchanged three-direction/two-epsilon interface at common center for both closures.

Restore/check native RNG, model/Adam/gradients/modes; verify unchanged shared clones, supplied exact preprocessing/TRAIN fingerprints, helper restoration and sealed sources. Return only JSON diagnostics and charged costs.

Root saves each report to a fresh engineering artifact path and preserves external-supervisor logs/costs. No usable returned arm state, new checkpoint, predictive continuation or score is saved by this harness. Inspect failures without an automatic rerun or tolerance/candidate change.

finite_operation_bounds_per_graph.scalar_search_budget: Unchanged frozen bisection_steps=40 and radius/radius_cap from original constants; each slot evaluated by each original selector exactly once

acceptance.cross_closure_values_and_returned_state: Exact keys, tensor dtype/shape/torch.equal and exact scalar equality; both state mappings normalized identically where CPU snapshots use dict containers
acceptance.inherited_AD_interface: Original initializer duality/finite-difference predicates and fixed epsilons, without epsilon search
acceptance.coverage: Missing noncommon scalar matching coverage is explicitly unresolved. Failed/null/abstaining arms remain their original source outcomes; no substitute basis, redraw, radius grid or new setting.
acceptance.scope: Passed comparisons establish cache engineering equivalence only for the supplied state/input pair; they cannot promote original native qualification or provide predictive evidence.

cost_accounting.total_harness_wall_and_CPU: Includes source verification, setup, fingerprints/snapshots and final checks; phase sum is a subset
cost_accounting.fixed_order: Original first, cached second; no order-balanced speed or continuation forecast claim

prohibited_scope: remote execution by this source preparation
